findings.title: Both version-4 readers accept a non-strict remediation candidate equal to the prior adverse review commit
findings.reproduction: At exact candidate cc2ce51c4d1f7d330530ee138eb5b70c96e0df98, create a disposable real-Git S02 history with an R01 packet, a changes-requested R01 ledger containing one blocking finding, and no later packet/remediation commit. Create an approved R02 ledger whose candidateCommit is exactly the R01 ledger introduction commit, whose packet hash is the unchanged R01 packet blob at that commit, and whose priorAttempt exactly references R01; then add a later human-approval marker with a matching closed/open projection. `recoveryctl.validate_v4_supplement_packet_review` returns successfully and `taskctl.recovery_v4_supplement_packet_review_errors` returns an empty list. Both implementations use inclusive `git_is_ancestor(prior_review_commit, successor_candidate)`, so equality passes. The R02 finding required strict candidate/review ancestry, and the approved packet requires adverse review remediation through a strict-descendant inert packet. The authority chain can therefore claim a new remediation attempt and close a blocker without any strict-descendant remediation candidate.
findings.requiredRemediation: Require every attempt after R01 to bind a candidate commit that is a strict descendant of the immediately preceding review-ledger introduction commit: reject equality in both recoveryctl and taskctl while retaining the existing exact packet blob/hash, canonical ledger, sequential-attempt, and full chronological finding/closure checks. Add an unmocked real-Git denial variant for candidateCommit equal to the prior adverse review commit in both readers, preserve the valid R01-adverse to R02-adverse to R03-approved chain, and submit fresh evidence. Keep GCR-0004 bridge lineage, v3 artifacts, the active hold, witness, revision 9-to-10-to-11 sequencing, historic-retry denial, and crash/recovery behavior unchanged.

notes: CHANGES_REQUESTED at exact frozen reviewed-state commit 94f4887ab2264bd0574ab3492297a98447d0debc, whose sole parent is candidate cc2ce51c4d1f7d330530ee138eb5b70c96e0df98. The incremental R03 implementation changes exactly tests/foundation/test_gcr3ctl.py, tools/recoveryctl.py, and tools/taskctl.py; the candidate-to-reviewed-state delta adds only exact R03 evidence and the canonical REVIEW submission. The exact three-round truncation reproduction and ten related adverse variants are rejected for both readers, and the valid complete chain passes; the focused first-round ledger test plus four predecessor/v3 compatibility tests also pass. Evidence and root-cause bindings are exact, prior R01 findings remain historically closed, GCR-0004 bridge lineage remains recorded, and the protected witness remains exact, untracked, unstaged, and non-authoritative. However, the independently reproduced strict-ancestry bypass leaves R02-F01 not fully remediated, so no closure is recorded and the broader qualification claims are not relied upon. No gcr3ctl review/adopt/recover, state/backlog transition, S02/B02 action, Wave/amendment/task/gate action, staging, commit, or witness mutation was performed.
